sourceFitAssessment.reasoning: PIP2 to PIP3 conversion is positioned at the membrane with the opposing PTEN direction. PIP3 recruitment leads to AKT below it, then an explicitly indirect relation to mTORC1. The returning dashed brake is identified as indirect negative feedback, with release possible rather than universal. The fictional phosphosite change cannot identify that wiring, dependence or benefit. The retained shared two-complex map supplies molecular detail but lacks the returning loop and distinct inhibitor overview; this narrow extension does not replace it.
